extraLines: docs/adr/0054-top-down-allocation.md	+The user asked to remove the parked page. `app/(app)/demand/top-down/` (the page, its components and its server actions) and `requireTopDownAccess` are deleted; the last commit that has them is `a9fa138d`, so restoring the page starts from `git show a9fa138d:<path>`. Three things stay, because removing them would need a data migration: the four `top_down_*` tables and the `top_down` forecast method, which still reads the stored targets for any variant that has it chosen. ADR 0163 later removed the `demand.topdown.edit` capability, and migration 0040 deletes its stored grants. `/edit/top-down` is a legacy URL of the Demand Plan page (`/demand/demand-plan`). The sections below describe the page as it was.
